mentions.name: VT Chat
mentions.description: A privacy-first AI chat application that keeps all conversations local while providing access to 15+ AI models including Claude 4 Sonnet and Claude 4 Opus, O3, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and DeepSeek R1. Features Deep Research for multi-step research with source verification, Pro Search integrating real-time web search grounded by Google Gemini, PDF document processing, a thinking mode that shows complete AI reasoning, structured extraction that turns documents into JSON, and AI-powered semantic routing that automatically activates tools based on queries. Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Turborepo in a monorepo setup.
